purpose: Phase-6D tumour treatment-response state machine (legal transitions) + deterministic response dynamics defaults. All values are SCHEMATIC tuning knobs for a normalized virtual tumour burden - never biological growth constants, kill coefficients, doubling times, or dose-response parameters. Regression requires net loss pressure; growth requires positive net growth pressure; strong regression is impossible without treatment.

forbidden_transitions: untreated_growth -> strong_regression (no treatment / no justified biological event)
state_machine.notes: Regression states are reachable only after treatment_started. Rebound states are reachable only after treatment_ended. There is no cure / complete_response / clinical_remission state.

defaults.growth_pressure_note: schematic baseline proliferative pressure of the untreated tumour (ordinal, not a growth rate)
defaults.loss_induction_scale_note: scales the ordinal formulation loss-induction class into the schematic pressure regime so regression is gradual (never an instant disappearance)
